subject.title: [Bug] QQ Bot: skill_workshop approval "Allow" button always recorded as rejected

question: When QQ Bot DMs are open and no explicit approval grant exists, should a C2C sender be allowed to approve privileged plugin actions?
rationale: Current shipped behavior separates permission to chat from permission to approve, while the linked pull request would collapse those boundaries for every direct conversation.

options.title: Keep explicit approval authority
options.body: Require execApprovals.approvers or an explicit non-wildcard allowFrom entry and improve the unauthorized-button experience.

options.title: Infer a canonical owner
options.body: Permit C2C approval only when the callback actor matches a separately established operator identity.

options.title: Trust every C2C sender
options.body: Treat any permitted direct-message sender as authorized for approval callbacks.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit approval authority
recommendation.body: Require execApprovals.approvers or an explicit non-wildcard allowFrom entry and improve the unauthorized-button experience.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQ Bot and cross-channel authorization work provides the strongest available security-boundary ownership signal.
